title: The Rough Horizon
author: Jonah Joubert
blurb: Oscar Kavanagh, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
